text:
sarah.k: Hey @support — we just finished the IdP attribute rename for AcmeCorp and now a couple of product managers report they can view a project but get 403 when trying to edit project settings. They were project-admin before. Console shows "permission denied (403)" when clicking Settings -> General. Can anyone triage?

james.s: Sorry about that — can you paste the project id, and one example user id so I can look up their effective roles? Also any recent SCIM sync job logs would help.

sarah.k: Project id is proj-01234. Example user is emily.p (their email emily.p@acme.com). We did a SCIM group rename from `Acme_Product_Owners` -> `acme-product-admins` and updated mapping in the IdP yesterday at ~15:12 UTC. SCIM sync job ran at 15:20 and reported 200 for the push but no detailed logs in our UI.

james.s: Looking up proj-01234... I see emily.p in org AcmeCorp and listed under project members but role shows `viewer` in the effective roles table. That's why edit is blocked. Two possible causes: 1) SCIM group mapping didn't map the new group name to the project_admin role; 2) there's an inherited deny or role propagation delay. Can you check IdP claim mapping for `memberOf` or the SCIM group names? Also did you change casing or spacing? mappings are case-sensitive.

sarah.k: IdP says claim `groups` now includes `acme-product-admins`. In our OIDC mapping we changed the rule to map `groups` -> `project_admin`. Here's the snippet we used in the IdP UI:

```
// pseudo config
claim: groups
match: /acme-product-admins/
map_to: project_admin
```

james.s: That looks reasonable. Can you run `GET /admin/v1/orgs/AcmeCorp/projects/proj-01234/members?expand=roles` with the admin token and paste the response (mask PII)? We need to confirm whether the platform received the group -> role assignment.

sarah.k: Pasting redacted output: "[{\"user\":\"emily.p\",\"roles\":[\"viewer\"],\"via\":\"scim:acme-product-admins\"}]" — interesting, shows via scim but role is viewer.

marta: tagging eng-sre-oncall — odd that via shows scim:acme-product-admins but role didn't change. Two hypotheses: A) role mapping table kept an old rule matching `Acme_Product_Owners` and we have a fallback to viewer when mapping fails; B) there's a race where project-level inheritance (org->project) applied a deny in another policy. I'm going to check the role-mapper service logs for the timeframe.

eng-sre-oncall: I pulled role-mapper traces for 2025-10-03T15:20:00Z (approx). There's an error in the mapper: `KeyError: 'acme-product-admins'` during normalization step, then it falls back to default_role=viewer. That suggests our normalization code didn't accept the new dashed name because we recently tightened the group-name regex. Filed internal issue RH-5483.

james.s: Great find. For a customer-facing workaround: we can manually grant emily.p `project-admin` on proj-01234 via the support CLI to restore edit access while we patch. Command: 

```
# support CLI (internal)
rwctl projects grant --project proj-01234 --user emily.p --role project_admin
```

sarah.k: Can you do that? A few PMs need to update settings right away.

james.s: Done. Confirmed emily.p now has project_admin and can edit settings. I also ran a bulk grant for the scim group members detected in the last sync to reduce customer pain.

idp-bot: SCIM sync summary for AcmeCorp at 2025-10-03T15:20Z: 412 members processed, 1 mapping error flagged (`acme-product-admins`), status: partial_success.

marta: We have a fix branch to relax the normalization regex and add an explicit mapping fallback. Patch in code review. Eng-sre will deploy a hotfix to role-mapper and then we should re-run the SCIM full sync to apply proper roles.

eng-sre-oncall: Deploy scheduled to canary at 18:00 UTC, full deploy 18:20 UTC. We'll monitor role propagation after deploy.

sarah.k: Thanks — please ping when resolved so I can tell the customer. Quick question: should we also recommend customers avoid renaming groups during business hours?

james.s: Short answer — yes, unless you have a maintenance window. Longer: SCIM group rename should be safe but if your IdP mapping uses strict regexes we may need to re-validate. We should also improve docs to note case/format sensitivity. Filing docs follow-up.

marta: Postmortem action: add validation in SCIM import to surface unmapped groups to admins (UI banner), add telemetry for mapping failures, and update docs. Ticket: DOC-2374; Telemetry: ENG-6080.

sarah.k: Customer notified that we applied a temporary grant and we're scheduling a follow-up once the hotfix is live. They were ok with manual workaround for now. Ty! :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [canary] role-mapper v1.4.7-hotfix deployed to canary at 2025-10-03T18:01:12Z

eng-sre-oncall: Canary looks good, no errors in mapper traces. Kicking full rollout.

deploy-bot: [prod] role-mapper v1.4.7-hotfix deployed to prod at 2025-10-03T18:22:03Z

marta: Re-ran SCIM full sync at 18:30 UTC. Verified mappings for `acme-product-admins` now produce `project_admin` role correctly. I removed the temporary support grants for users who were supposed to be admins and validated access.

sarah.k: Confirmed with customer: emily.p and team can now edit settings without support help. Closing for now.

james.s: Follow-ups: 1) backfill unmapped group telemetry, 2) docs note for IdP group naming, 3) add a support playbook entry for this exact symptom -> quick grant + escalate to eng-sre. I've added all three to the internal support queue.

marta: Closing RH-5483 as fixed in prod. Marking customer case 789012 as resolved.

sarah.k: Thanks team!
